messages.subject: For Sanjiv Lamba | Industrial gases, hydrogen and government stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Pelaez,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Sanjiv Lamba, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

Linde's global industrial-gases and hydrogen portfolio operates at the intersection of public policy, industrial investment, decarbonisation and customer transformation. That environment aligns strongly with the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I also support stakeholder governance around a large industrial renewable-energy platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and industrial-transition stakeholder strategy might support Linde's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Linde.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
